headline: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
body: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Press Release
body: CDSL has informed the Exchange regarding Media Release relating to financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
body: CDSL has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: General Updates
body: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Disclosure under Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (SEBI Listing Regulations).

headline: Retirement
body: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Retirement of Shri Ashish Bhatt, Senior Vice President, Operations.

headline: Analysts/Institutional Investor Meet/Con. Call Updates
body: CDSL has informed the Exchange about Schedule of Conference Call to be held on Monday, November 02, 2026.
